name: Extract Act End Context
description: Extracts complete narrative state from end of movie act for continuity bridging

system_prompts.name: Extract Act End Context
system_prompts.content:
You are a script supervisor extracting the EXACT state at the end of a movie act. Be precise about:
- Who is alive vs dead
- Exact emotional states
- What each character knows
- Physical locations and props
- Unresolved plot threads

This data will be used to maintain continuity in the next act. Accuracy is critical — any errors here will create continuity violations.

user_prompt:
Extract the complete state at the end of Act {{act_number}}:

---
{{act_content}}
---

Return a JSON object with the full ActContextBridge structure including:
- characterStates (each character with isAlive, emotionalState, location, injuries, knowsFacts, doesNotKnow)
- openThreads and resolvedThreads
- promises (plot setups needing payoff)
- currentLocation (name, presentCharacters, establishedDetails)
- toneVector (humor, darkness, romance, action, suspense as 0-1)
- stakesLevel and tensionLevel (1-10)
- mustResolve, mustNotInclude, setupsToPayoff
- carryForwardContext (2-3 sentence summary paragraph)

act_number.description: The act that has just ended

act_content.description: The full text of the completed act

output.schema_for_llm: { bridge: { actNumber: number, actTitle: string, characterStates: [{ name: string, isAlive: boolean, emotionalState: string, location: string }], openThreads: string[], resolvedThreads: string[], promises: string[], currentLocation: { name: string, presentCharacters: string[] }, toneVector: { [dimension: string]: number (0-1) }, stakesLevel: number (1-10), tensionLevel: number (1-10), carryForwardContext: string } }
